CORRUPTED PROFESSOR'S ASSISTANT: DRAVEN WILLOWCREST Medium, Humanoid, Human, Chaotic Neutral ![](images/0.jpg) DRAVEN WILLOWCREST WAS ONCE A BUDDING NECROMANCER AT THE PRESTIGIOUS STORMSPIRE ACADEMY. WITH A SHARP MIND AND A THIRST FOR KNOWLEDGE, HE WAS AN INVALUABLE ASSISTANT TO HIS PROFESSOR, DELVING INTO FORBIDDEN TOMES AND INCANTATIONS. TRAGICALLY, HIS AMBITION LED HIM INTO THE CLUTCHES OF A SINISTER CULT, MASKED UNDER THE GUISE OF AN ACADEMIC STUDY GROUP. NOW CORRUPTED, DRAVEN'S PALE FORM MOVES THROUGH THE SHADOWS OF THE ACADEMY, SERVING AS A COVERT AGENT FOR THE CULT WHILE CONTINUING TO ASSIST HIS OBLIVIOUS PROFESSOR. HIS EYES, ENCIRCLED BY THE SHADOWS OF ENDLESS NIGHTS SPENT IN DARK REVERIE, NOW GLINT WITH A SUBTLE, SINISTER AWARENESS. PERHAPS SOME PART OF HIS NOBLE SPIRIT REMAINS, BUT IT IS SHROUDED BENEATH LAYERS OF MALIGN INFLUENCE. Armor Class : 12 Hit Points: 22 Hit Dice : 4d8+4 Speed: walk : 30
